thread:
alex_g: looping in security/legal — customer (Northbridge Health) opened an escalated ticket about the confidentiality addendum and audit logs. they say: during a scheduled KMS rotation on 2026-02-15 they saw 401s and missing audit entries. asking for HSM attestation + exact audit export for 2026-02-15 02:45-04:15 UTC.
paul_northbridge: thanks alex — we need a formal response for our compliance team. specifically: 1) does the addendum/BAA cover audit logs retention for 7 years? 2) can you provide an attestation that keys are protected by HSM and not exportable (BYOK scenario)? 3) full timeline for the 02/15 event (why 401s happened & any log gaps). we also saw a billing spike at ~03:05 UTC, please explain.
maria_s: thanks — noted. quick clarifying q: is Northbridge using Redwood-managed KMS or BYOK HSM keys? paul_northbridge: BYOK, we provided key material last quarter and flagged it as HSM-wrapped.
sam_t: tagging infra root cause folks. initial hypothesis: during key rollover we had a short window where token validation touched the old key id and the new key wasn't fully propagated to all regions — could cause 401s plus suppressed audit writes if write path retried incorrectly. need audit export to confirm gaps.
jenny_p: legal here — we can confirm standard BAA language re: logs/retention but confidentiality addendum (customer-specific) may add retention terms. I'll need the signed addendum PDF and whether they requested extended retention.
oncall-bot: escalation created and assigned to eng-infra oncall (INC-2026-1845) :rotating_light:
security_ops_bot: created ticket INF-8492 for security investigation; assigned to sam_t and dpo. please attach the customer's signed addendum and sample log range.
alex_g: attaching customer's ticket excerpt and their export request: `request: "audit_export: start=2026-02-15T02:45:00Z end=2026-02-15T04:15:00Z format=jsonl include=all` — customer also pasted a short log snippet showing a decrypt error.
paul_northbridge: here's the log snippet we saw in our audit stream (redacted):
```
{"ts":"2026-02-15T03:05:12Z","service":"auth","level":"error","msg":"key unwrap failed","key_id":"cust-key-7","err":"hsm: unable to unwrap - missing key material"}
{"ts":"2026-02-15T03:05:14Z","service":"api","level":"warn","msg":"401 unauthorized","path":"/v1/generate","request_id":"r-9z3"}
```
maria_s: good repro. next steps I propose: (A) eng-infra run rotation-replay test in staging with a BYOK key to reproduce propagation window (B) pull audit rows from primary region for requested window and compare to retention DB (C) provide HSM attestation doc or pointer to our KMS/HSM provider SLA.
sam_t: I can run (A) tonight and will capture telemetry: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/metadata?key_id=cust-key-7` then check kv-prop logs: `grep "propagated to" /var/log/propagator.log` — I'll share the exact commands and outputs.
jenny_p: legal needs one thing: if we confirm a missed audit write, does Redwood's addendum commit to producing a signed incident timeline and remediation? I'll draft a statement but need product/security confirmation.
alex_g: customer also asked about billing spike — they saw a token charge increase between 03:03-03:10 UTC. could be retries doubling token usage. include cost impact in the response.
oncall-bot: reminder: please keep PII out of channel. use secure doc upload for attachments.
security_ops_bot: note: require HSM attestation (CNAS-2026 form) from our HSM vendor; DPO notified (dpo@redwood). I'll attach vendor attestation when we get it.
paul_northbridge: timeline is slightly urgent — compliance team gave us a 48h window for a formal response.
maria_s: understood. I will: 1) start audit export request (obs-export-ID: obs-2026-1121) for the exact window, 2) run rotation-replay test tonight, 3) capture token/retry histogram for billing delta. expected ETA for first artifacts: ~8h.
sam_t: got it. if we reproduce, mitigation is: backfill missing audit writes (if any) and place a short-term config to queue audit writes until propagation completes. I'll prepare rollbacks and a canary.
jenny_p: legal will prepare preliminary language for the customer confirming: - BAA covers audit logging obligations per standard template; - addendum specifics will be confirmed once we validate retention policy; - we will provide HSM attestation (or explain if vendor provides only control attestations).
alex_g: I'll reply to Paul with the plan + safe timeframe. tagging @paul_northbridge so he sees the 48h commitment.
paul_northbridge: thanks team — please make sure the attestation mentions "keys not exportable" and includes vendor timestamp + signature. also include whether we can get a notarized statement for our auditors.
maria_s: noted — will escalate attestation request. posting next updates here; closing loop in 8h with artifacts. :thumbsup:
